overview.note: One playthrough, no difficulty settings, no online trophies, no mission replay. Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off, and keep manual saves at the start and end of every chapter.

stages.goal: Finish Gone Fishing and Chapter 1 — and after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house in the morning and Accept her meditation. That spot is the run's only missable: it disappears when Chapter 1 ends.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — Start Clean, Miss Nothing

stages.goal: Play the campaign through all five chapters to the final mission. Every trophy here is automatic story progress; along the way, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars so the later counters are already moving.
stages.title: The Story — Chapters 2 to 5

stages.goal: Clear the named strands: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton's seven shipwrecks, Billy's mud-club jobs, Randy's 16-car Wish List, Tyrone's labs (Jason only) and Bret's hunts — plus any 8 counting Strangers & Freaks strands such as Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. All of them survive into free-roam.
stages.title: Stranger Strands

stages.goal: Sample all 9 activity types, then grind the counters: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins and 50 challenges. Range sessions also build the Focus that Gunslinger needs.
stages.title: Activities & Skill Grinds

stages.goal: Partner crimes open after Coffee Break: rob 3 shops back-to-back, lose a 4-star heat together, rob 5 bank vaults, one Illegal Operation per gang — plus the set pieces: the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero Rhino, the showroom Banshee and Kingpin Bowling.
stages.title: Crime, Partners & Set Pieces

stages.goal: Sweep the collection counters: 3 card sets (15 for the checklist), 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicle discoveries and a fully unfogged map of all 52 areas — with the one-off scenes on the way: the Ocean Beach cocktail, the prologue store revisited on foot, the Kelly County UFO and 10 bike kicks in a minute.
stages.title: Collectibles & Exploration

stages.goal: Turn crime into assets: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through fences (Yasmani pays best), spend $100,000 across all shops, buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 through the Vice City Real Estate app, then register 10 cheap vehicles with Scooter Bros.
stages.title: Money & Property

stages.goal: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist: about 60% of the game, with all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests in full, any 70 of 80 challenges and 100 optional missions. The platinum follows automatically.
stages.title: 100% Completion & the Platinum
